robot.name: PAL Robotics TIAGo OMNI (single-arm omnidirectional mobile robot; wrist awaiting a dedicated end effector)

mobile.source: Official PAL Robotics tiago_robot and omni_base_robot whole-robot description at pinned versions; base_type=omni_base. Versions, licenses and resource digests are in data/robots/tiago_omni/provenance.json.
approximations: Base 720×500×310 mm per the official omnidirectional base documentation; 73.1860860411 kg is the summed inertial mass of the selected model without end effector, not a measured base mass.
The stock four-wheel structure is kept; planar X/Y motion and yaw are used as layout coordinates, without simulating mecanum roller contact, wheel-speed control or localization error.
Lift range 0 to 0.35 m, default 0.20 m; mount_height is the actual shoulder height in that pose, 0.9372 m. Distance recommendations do not yet search over lift poses or inverse kinematics.
Vendor joint limits and inertial parameters are kept; force-limited position servos are an engineering approximation, not the stock controller. Mesh collisions use MuJoCo convex-hull contact.

By default the wrist has no stock gripper and uses the existing dedicated end-effector generation and assembly workflow, avoiding stacked grippers. stock_gripper.xml is a whole-robot display configuration with the stock parallel gripper.
The vendor's 0.87 m reach and 3 kg payload at full extension exclude the end effector; the dedicated end-effector mass is counted in the existing payload check.
